Joins 2025 code-violation counts per tract to CDC PLACES adult high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, keeps tracts with non-null paired values, and returns the overall correlation and paired-tract count on every row.
sql: WITH violation_counts AS (SELECT geoid, SUM(CAST(n AS DOUBLE)) AS violation_count FROM fw_pg.tract_counts WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_6f8956' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all' GROUP BY geoid), health AS (SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation, CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence FROM session.fw_6f8956_m2_cdc WHERE bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL), paired_tracts AS (SELECT t.name AS tract_name, COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count, h.totalpopulation, (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation * 1000) AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence, t.geoid FROM fw_pg.tracts t LEFT JOIN violation_counts v ON t.geoid = v.geoid LEFT JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid WHERE h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0) SELECT tract_name, code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, violation_count, totalpopulation, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence, CORR(code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_vs_prevalence_correlation, COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts, geoid FROM paired_tracts ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC LIMIT 200
